visual.general_description: Composite chart of the patient's drug regimen, anti-MDA5 antibody labels, cutaneous involvement, serum ferritin and oxygenation support.
visual.detailed_description: Top: mPSL row with three groups of three downward arrows and a printed 1 g daily label. Below it a stepped dark PSL bar with printed doses from 60 mg down to 10 mg. Next a gray IV-CsA block (140 mg daily) followed by an oral-CsA bar with printed 270, 300 and 270 mg. Below, IVCY downward arrows (six labelled 500 mg and one labelled 750 mg) and an RTX label (700 mg) with four downward triangles. Boxed anti-MDA5 antibody labels read >150 indexes (left), 112 indexes (middle right) and 44 indexes (far right). A light-gray band labelled cutaneous involvements rises and then falls after the RTX triangles. A black line with dots labelled serum ferritin (ng/mL) is drawn on a 0-1500 axis: it rises early to a peak, falls, rises again, then declines over the right part to low values. Bottom: oxygenation support blocks labelled 1 L, 1.5 L and 1 L. No dates or patient identifiers are printed.
